correctness.rationale: PASS — The signed antichain construction on an ordinal sum of r nonempty antichains gives E={x:Σ||x^(i)||∞≤1}; its polar is a product of cross-polytopes. Facets are indexed by signed selected coordinates, F=Π(2a_i), with normal norm sqrt r, and polar edges change one block. For a_i≥2 this gives F(a_i−1) ridges at exterior angle arccos((r−1)/r); singleton levels contribute F/2 ridges each at arccos((r−2)/r). The facet and two ridge-area Dirichlet integrals, including Gram factors sqrt r, sqrt(2r−1), sqrt(r−1), cancel all nonsingleton a_i in area/volume ratios. Thus V_{n−1}/Vol=n sqrt r/2 and V_{n−2}/Vol=n(n−1)K(r,s)/(4π), K=(r−s)sqrt(2r−1)acos((r−1)/r)+s sqrt(r−1)acos((r−2)/r), with n≥3, r≥2. Direct independent profile checks reproduce all polar-edge counts and stated normalized values; finite code corroborates, but the beta-integral/polar-edge proof covers all integer profiles.
